thread:
maya: Hi team, first-day laptop hiccup. MDM enrolled but FileVault toggle in System Settings is greyed out and Jamf shows "Encryption pending". I ran `sudo fdesetup status` and it says 'Encryption in progress' but it's been like that for >2 hours. Any tips?

it-ops: Welcome, Maya! Can you paste the serial? Also which macOS version and model?

maya: Serial C02Y0ABCDEF1, MacBook Air M2, macOS 13.6. I enrolled through the People Ops onboarding link this morning.

olivia: Two quick checks: 1) Is the Mac connected to the corp VPN or behind a captive portal? Institutional key escrow requires callback to Jamf. 2) `sudo fdesetup list` to see if a recovery key is present.

maya: Running `sudo fdesetup list` yields nothing. No VPN; on home wifi (not captive). Jamf shows profile "Company Security - FileVault" installed.

security: Institutional escrow sometimes stalls until the device can reach our KMS. Can you try `sudo jamf recon` and post the output lines near encryption? If it still doesn't complete we can push a force-escrow via Jamf.

maya: `sudo jamf recon` output snippet:
Enrollment Complete
MDM: profile installed
FileVault: Escrow attempt failed - network error

it-ops: Ah — network error. Home networks occasionally block the ports we use for key escrow (443 + some ephemeral). Can you temporarily tether to a phone hotspot and run `sudo jamf policy -trigger filevault_escrow`? That will force the escrow upload.

maya: Switching to hotspot now.

jamf-bot: Policy filevault_escrow queued by maya at 2026-03-23T15:12:00Z.

maya: Ran `sudo jamf policy -trigger filevault_escrow` - looks like it completed. `sudo fdesetup status` now shows 'FileVault is On.' :relieved:

olivia: Great. A couple follow-ups we'll add to the onboarding doc: - If encryption shows "in progress" >30m, try recon + policy on a network that allows outbound TLS. - If the recovery key doesn't escrow, we can create a temporary admin and do a manual escrow from console.

security: We'll also verify the escrow record in the console. @people-ops please note network requirement on the new-hire checklist (hotspot or corp VPN if enrolling offsite).

people-ops: Noted, will update checklist. Congrats and welcome again, Maya!

maya: Thanks all, appreciate the quick help.
